annotation.title_clean: Guía para entidades públicas y privadas en materia de Transparencia y Protección de Datos Personales para una Inteligencia Artificial responsable (Versión preliminar)
annotation.title_en: Guide for Public and Private Entities on Transparency and Personal Data Protection for Responsible Artificial Intelligence (Preliminary Version)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Agencia de Acceso a la Información Pública (AAIP), Argentina
annotation.venue: Agencia de Acceso a la Información Pública (AAIP)
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: Preliminary guidance from Argentina's access-to-information agency (AAIP) for public and private entities using AI in automated decision-making. It sets transparency and personal-data-protection principles and gives recommendations across four AI lifecycle stages: design, verification and validation, implementation, and operation and maintenance.
key_provisions_or_claims: Applies data minimisation and data quality principles from the design stage of AI systems.
Requires traceability and auditability of AI systems across the whole lifecycle.
People should be informed when they interact with an AI system or when their data is processed by one.
Recommendations are organised in four lifecycle stages: design, verification and validation, implementation, operation and maintenance.
Draws on OECD and UNESCO principles and highlights risks of bias, privacy violations and opacity, especially for vulnerable groups.
